AAR delivers award-winning aerospace and defense services to airlines, OEMs, and governments across the globe.

Based in the Chicago area since 1955, AAR is the number one aviation maintenance, repair, and overhaul provider in North America. With a unique combination of industry-leading parts, repair, government solutions, and software, AAR is a trusted partner to commercial and government customers worldwide.
As your trusted aircraft parts supplier and distributor, AAR delivers a broad range of products across all major commercial and government platforms globally.
Our trusted Airframe MRO and Component MRO teams provide comprehensive repair services while prioritizing the highest levels of quality and safety.
AAR's software offerings combine the latest technology and customer feedback to provide innovative solutions to airlines, MROs, and cargo companies.
AAR provides comprehensive maintenance and supply chain programs, shelter and sustainment systems, and parts to governments across the globe.
Commercial parts shipped and received in FY2026
There’s no one like AAR.
Impressive mix of aftermarket solutions

AAR is a global aerospace and defense aftermarket solutions company with operations in over 20 countries. Headquartered in the Chicago area, AAR supports commercial and government customers through four operating segments: Parts Supply; Repair, Engineering, and Software; Government Solutions; and Legacy Commercial Programs. Additional information can be found at aarcorp.com .

AAR's software offerings combine the latest technology and customer feedback to provide innovative solutions to airlines, MROs, and cargo companies.
More than 10,000 aircraft rely on AAR's software.
Mobilize maintenance with cutting edge software solutions

AAR subsidiary Trax is the preeminent global provider of aviation software, delivering a fully integrated, cloud-hosted ERP solution through its flagship product, eMRO, and its eMobility suite of mobile apps.
Simplify long-range heavy maintenance planning
AAR subsidiary Aerostrat automates complex scheduling, ensures production capacity, and simplifies aircraft allocation with Aerros, its flagship ERP-agnostic solution.
AAR subsidiary Airvoyant automates the sourcing process with an AI-capable platform to help airlines and MROs reduce costs, minimize order delays, limit AOG exposure, and improve on-time performance.
Maximize aircraft warranty management and value engineering services

AAR subsidiary Airinmar delivers tailored component repair and warranty management support services, driving reduced repair expenditure, improved component availability, and enhanced operational efficiencies.
